description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmploymentStatusService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods including deletion, retrieval by ID, saving, and search functionalities of employment statuses, utilizing mock objects and test data setup.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmploymentStatusService methods, including mocking the DAO layer and verifying service behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the service instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employment status entries via the service layer.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of an employment status by ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests the saving (creating or updating) of an employment status object.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Verifies the search functionality returning a list of employment statuses based on search parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Checks the count of search results based on specified search filters.
